_format: trine-eval Planner sprint entries (number, title, features, estimated_complexity, dependencies) extended with id, phase, repo, exit_criteria and level5_decisions. Each entry is meant to be pasted into the target repo's .harness/sprints.json as a new phase (a Level 5 edit of a sacred file), or to seed /trine-eval:harness-kickoff where the repo has no harness yet.

phases.title: Baseline: meta-repo, decisions, sensor fix, billing check, carry-overs
Definition of done for research, writing and quantitative work
Discovery Gate: scope as a governed, re-reviewable package
Headless parity in the cloud, containment, runtime gate

sprints.title: Bootstrap the meta-repo: plan, ADRs, manifest, workspace, index schema, archivist task
features: PLAN.md
plan/sprints.json
decisions/ADR-0001..0005
manifest.json
workspace/sync.sh
index/work-record.schema.json
archivist/briefing-task.md
exit_criteria: Level 5 ratification of ADR-0001..0005 recorded in decisions/README.md

sprints.title: Replace the tool-call audit logger with the native PostToolUse implementation
features: hooks/log-tool-call.sh rebuilt per auto-mate/docs/handoff/council-native-hooks (reads tool_input and cwd from the hook payload; repo root from the payload cwd; writes only when .council/ exists)
hooks/win/log-tool-call.ps1 parity or an explicit deferral recorded as a henka record
andon_pull_count removed from the hook; andon becomes a policy evaluated over audit-log.jsonl in council-autorun Step 1E
tests: fixture payloads for Read, Edit, Bash, Grep; assertion of 0 unknown summaries and no .council/ created outside the repo root
audit-log-entry schema gains session_id and tool_use_id (additive); the hook writes both from the payload so tool-call sequences join to sessions and diagnostics (ADR-0006)
exit_criteria: one full sprint in a governed repo with 0 audit entries carrying file_path=unknown
no phantom .council/ directories

sprints.title: Session diagnostics hook: one event per session into .council/diagnostics.jsonl
features: hooks/session-diagnostics.sh on SessionEnd: sums message.usage over the transcript by model and effort, splits sidechain (subagent) usage, counts tool calls by tool from this session's audit entries, counts compactions and subagents from PreCompact and SubagentStart markers, reads the current sprint from .harness/sprint-state.json, appends one kind=session event conforming to cloud-catcher index/diagnostic-event.schema.json
PreCompact and SubagentStart hooks write minimal marker lines the SessionEnd hook counts (no bodies)
hooks/enforce-append-only.sh covers .council/diagnostics.jsonl; rotate-audit-log.py handles it the same way
scripts/measure-projection-cost.py appends a kind=projection-cost event when a .council/ exists
schema copy under schemas/diagnostic-event.schema.json kept byte-identical to cloud-catcher's (a test diffs them)
PowerShell parity or recorded deferral; tests with a fixture transcript whose totals are known
exit_criteria: a fixture session ends with exactly one session event whose token totals equal the transcript sum
no prompt or response text appears in any event

sprints.title: Usage capture: structured JSON from every headless agent invocation
features: DirectCrewAdapter and gate-lib.sh invoke claude -p with --output-format json; the adapter parses session_id, total_cost_usd, the per-model breakdown, usage, duration and num_turns into CrewResult.usage; gate-lib.sh prints a USAGE: json line after the verdict that CommandGate parses into Verdict.usage
a Usage model mirroring the diagnostic-event usage object; cost_source recorded as claude-code-estimate
RunRecord.usage aggregates crew and gate usage; printed today, persisted by P2-AM-2
dry-run returns synthetic usage of zero so the lifecycle demo still runs; tests assert the parsed fields from recorded fixture output
exit_criteria: a recorded claude -p json fixture yields non-null crew and gate usage in the run record

sprints.title: Billing surface check and August-review carry-overs
features: one headless `claude -p` run with the API key set; confirm the usage line in the Console; record in ADR-0001 addendum
re-validate undocumented agent frontmatter (context: fork, thinking:) against the current Claude Code runtime before the next harness sprint
trine-eval: review the default model and pricing table against the current price list (Opus 5.5 is current; its effort default is medium, set it explicitly)
auto-mate docs and cloud-setup: pin no-mistakes at v1.48.0
exit_criteria: ADR-0001 addendum written
level5_decisions: which surface should spend the credits

sprints.title: Rubrics and contract guidance for research reports and quantitative models
features: skills/eval-rubric/rubrics/research-report.md: dimensions for claim traceability (every load-bearing claim cites a source with a re-runnable check), reasoning quality, scope fidelity to the contract, prose quality; hard threshold: untraceable load-bearing claims fail the sprint

skills/eval-rubric/rubrics/quant-model.md: dimensions for correctness against closed-form or reference cases, reproducibility (seed determinism, pinned inputs), statistical validity (convergence, confidence intervals, calibration or backtest where applicable), code quality; hard thresholds: no reference-case parity test, or non-deterministic results under a fixed seed
rubrics/README.md decision guide rows and eval-rubric SKILL.md listing
sprint-contract/SKILL.md: a 'document deliverable' subsection: behavioral criteria for documents (commands that check sources, figures regenerated from code, word or section budgets), bucket guidance
bootstrap-failures/templates/by-rubric/research-report.json and quant-model.json seeded from known failure modes (fabricated citations, unlabeled assumptions, silent unit errors, overfit backtests)
exit_criteria: both rubrics load through eval-rubric
weights sum to 100
each has at least one hard threshold

sprints.title: Kickoff, evaluator tooling and summary support for the two project types
features: harness-kickoff: project types research-report and quant-model with rubric mapping; detection hints (reports/ or docs/ with front matter; notebooks or model packages)
evaluator_tools: python available for numeric checks; playwright never for these types
harness-summary: N/A handling for edge-case and smoke sections; per-dimension rollups for the new rubrics
a worked example contract per type under skills/sprint-contract/examples/
exit_criteria: kickoff on a fixture research project writes a config.json with the right rubric
a fixture quant sprint grades end to end

sprints.title: Cost and usage next to pass rates
features: harness-sprint records per-sprint cost_usd and tokens in sprint-state.json when a session event or run record for the sprint exists (derived, nullable)
harness-summary adds cost per PASS sprint, cost per criterion, cache share of input, and compactions per session to the Consistency and ACI sections
the Evaluator transcript trailer gains optional usage fields when the evaluator can observe them
exit_criteria: harness-summary over the validation set reports cost per PASS and cache share

sprints.repo: a scratch project repo (new, e.g. risk-engine-spike)
sprints.title: Validation set: five real tasks through the harness with the new rubrics
features: three research memos and two risk-model spikes drawn from current work
config.trials = 2 for the two quant sprints
harness-summary over the five; record first-round pass, pass^k, untestable-criterion rate

untestable criteria below 20% of criteria authored

sprints.title: Human-approval log writer and the ratify-to-approval wiring

sprints.title: Scope reference as the execution precondition
features: models.ScopeRef and Task.scope
council adapter: reads .council/state/effective-autonomy.json and .council/human-approvals.jsonl from the task repo; absent .council/ means ungoverned
validation before worktree provisioning: approval exists, approved, artifact_sha256 matches git show <base_ref>:<path>, grants cover push-branch and open-draft-pr
CLI: --scope PATH --approval APPR-NNNN; AUTOMATE_REQUIRE_SCOPE
tests against a governed fixture repo and an ungoverned one; docs/architecture.md update
exit_criteria: the four verification cases in ADR-0003 pass as tests

sprints.title: Persisted run records, autonomy-aware shipping, verdict evidence
features: RunRecord persisted to <workspace_root>/runs/<repo-slug>/<task-id>-<utc>.json on every run (and ReviewRecord alongside reviews)
Verdict.evidence (verdict line and findings) and Verdict.autonomy_at_gate

RunRecord.scope echoes the ScopeRef and approval id
docs: cloud division of labor, AUTOMATE_WORKSPACE_ROOT pointing at a cloud-catcher checkout's runs/ in cloud environments

Level 4 fixture: shipped, record on disk with evidence

sprints.title: Ingest auto-mate run records into the henka register
features: scripts/ingest-run-record.py: maps verdicts to henka records (Method / gate-verdict / passive; impact by verdict and ship outcome; detected_by auto-mate/<gate>; evidence cites run path and verdict line); appends via append-henka.py; idempotent on run path
council-autorun Step 1A invokes it over a configured runs directory before the pre-sprint check
council-detect reports pending-ingest counts
tests with recorded run-record fixtures from P2-AM-2
ingest also emits kind=run, crew and gate diagnostic events into .council/diagnostics.jsonl for the repo the run targeted
exit_criteria: one henka record per verdict
second ingest appends nothing

copies new events from each repo's .council/diagnostics.jsonl and derives run/crew/gate events from runs/*.json into index/diagnostics/events-<YYYY-MM>.jsonl, deduplicated by event_id

writes each project's diagnostics rollup block (7-day and 30-day tokens and cost by source, cost per shipped run, cost per PASS sprint, cache share, tool failure rate, compactions and subagents per session)

gate-mode flags for henkaten-detector and architect

sprints.title: council-gate skill: two-wave dispatch, decision states, Goldfish wave, re-entry
features: skills/council-gate/SKILL.md: wave 1 four reviewers, wave 2 architect synthesis; four decision states with outputs under .council/proposed/GATE-NNNN.md
Goldfish wave: /egm-review on the spec draft in a zero-context session (EGM pinned to a commit); fallback to a forked evaluator subagent when the plugin is absent
inputs: captures from cloud-catcher inbox/<project>/ and persisted plans from from-plan
re-entry: early-warning triggers from the henkaten projection; re-review when a sacred file changes mid-flight (henka record plus gate re-entry)
